text:
luca: Heads-up from a pen test on a private install (client-psi). KMS shim returned success for unwraps but there's no immutable audit record in the customer's local SIEM. this looks like an RBAC + netpol interaction.
mei: Can you share which shim and SA?
luca: shim=cloud-kms-shim v1.4.1, sa=svc-kms-shim@client-psi.terraform. curl: ```POST /v1/unwrap
Authorization: Bearer <tok>
{"key":"psi-main-key","ct":"..."}```
logs: `2025-05-09T09:12:01Z INFO unwrap ok request=un-9f3` but no audit file created.
devops-bot: deploy: private-edge rev d77 deployed 2025-05-09T08:00 UTC
vault-bot: audit-agent: file-rotate skipped (no write permission) path=/var/psi/audit/un-9f3
ana: That points to a file permission issue on the audit mount. did the customer change the PVC or mountOptions?
own: Customer applied a stricter netpol and also updated their storageclass to use fsGroup=0 to match infra standards. fsGroup=0 makes files root-owned which breaks non-root shim.
luca: So three failures: (1) netpol blocks external forward, (2) shim can't write locally due to fsGroup, (3) RBAC change removed the shim ability to call the local audit forwarder service account. messy.
mei: Short-term: re-add fsGroup override to the CSI snapshot and set fsGroup=2000 for the audit volume. Also re-grant fs-write role to svc-kms-shim. I'll open a hotfix PR.
ana: For private installs we should include a preflight that validates audit volume ownership + netpol egress intent before leaving install wizard. will add to installer checklist.
own: Also proposal: make audit writing resilient: shim should attempt local write as UID 0 fallback only for audit (with explicit acceptance), or run a small sidecar as root that owns the mount and exposes a write API the shim calls.
luca: Sidecar approach looks clean for air-gapped customers. add security review for sidecar (least privilege, SELinux label).
mei: Alerting gap: our metric audit_forward_attempts was 0 so no alert. add new indicator audit_expected_buckets that compares enrollment profile (airgap vs standard) to actual forward attempts.
own: For incident handling: INC-2025-058 opened. remediation steps: 1) set fsGroup=2000 on audit PVC (hotfix), 2) regrant svc-kms-shim fs-write role, 3) redeploy shim, 4) verify un-9f3 present in /var/psi/audit and in customer SIEM.
ana: I'll draft the runbook + quick checklist for SOC. include command snippets: `kubectl -n psi exec -it shim -- ls -l /var/psi/audit` and `curl -sS https://siem.client-psi.local/query?req=un-9f3`
mei: I'll push PR + hotfix and post back when staged. assigning to @mei.
luca: Thanks all. follow-up in 30. :thumbsup:
